Mixed list: ordered list nested inside unordered list

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<ul><li>Item A<ol><li>Sub 1</li><li>Sub 2</li></ol></li><li>Item B</li></ul>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
